name: @avatark/encounter-realization-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 14's encounter-realization derivation: a deterministic, causal AVAILABLE -> REALIZED/EXPIRED/BLOCKED resolver, bounded consequence derivation, and content-derived EncounterRecord identity. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral. Never applies a consequence itself -- that boundary is the Host layer's (lib/encounterRealization/hostService.ts), the same posture every sibling runtime package already holds.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
